title: Three Months and One Short Scale
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：receipt　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 receipt 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 the shopkeeper ① kept the receipt that no buyer in the shop would have noted, and he said the keeping was the whole of the month. The ② receipt, meaning the slip itself and not the scale, ran three months and stayed unnoted in the book; a receipt, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ receipt in that shop had the same short scale beside it, and the ④ receipt at the far counter, meaning the coin they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A receipt, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the shopkeeper said the noting is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the receipt was the whole of the matter, meaning the proof and not the slip. The ⑥ receipt, meaning the proof and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; receipt, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both a slip and a proof. He said the proof is the part they remember.

By 1997 the ⑦ receipt had become a line in an account, and the account had become an argument about the short scale. The ⑧ receipt of the whole thing, the shopkeeper wrote in July, was one shop and three months of noting; receipt, he said, is either the coin at the far counter or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ receipt I remember is the slip noted in the account, which closed in 1999 and is still noted as the quietest in the shop. A ⑩ receipt, my mother said in 2001, is the only slip that improves by being noted; every receipt, she said, is a proof that has agreed to look like a slip. She said the proof was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 收据（指铺子里每一张旁边的那一张）
B. n. 收据（指那张收据本身，与小小的秤相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep the receipt 收好这一张收据
D. n. 收据（指留给孩子们数的那一枚）
E. n. 收据之事（抽象总称，指一处铺子的收据之事）
F. n. 收据（指账本里写到、被记下的那一张）
G. n. 收据、凭据（指一件事里人人都买却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 凭据（抽象总称，指人人都买却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: kept the receipt that no buyer in the shop would have noted

answers.why: keep the receipt 意为“收好这一张收据”，1992 年那位掌柜把铺子里没有一位买主肯记下的一张收据做了一遍。
receipt 意为“收据”，指那张收据本身而不是小小的秤，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记下。
receipt 意为“收据”，指铺子里每一张旁边的那一张，每一张旁边都有同一杆小小的秤。
receipt 意为“收据”，指最远那张柜台的留给孩子们数的那一枚，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
receipt 意为“收据、凭据”，指一件事里人人都买却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这张凭据就是那件事的全部。
receipt 意为“凭据”，指人人都买却无人提起的那样东西而不是那张收据，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
receipt 意为“收据”，指账本里写到、被记下的那一张，到 1997 年这一张成了账本里的一行。
receipt 意为“收据之事”，掌柜七月写道，整件事的收据之事是一处铺子和三个月份的记下。
receipt 意为“收据”，我记得的是账本里记下过的那一张，1999 年结清了，至今仍被说成铺子里最安静的一张。
receipt 为抽象总称，母亲 2001 年说，收据是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的收据。
